newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi develops ASIC with combined DRAM, logic.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi develops ASIC with combined DRAM, logic.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd said on Tuesday it developed a new application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) which combines dynamic random access memory (DRAM) and logic in a single silicon chip.

Through the adoption of a DRAM micromodule architecture, the chip increases efficiency in data transfers by upto 100 times that of systems which use an external DRAM, and also reduces power requirement by up to one-twentieth of that of previous systems, Hitachi said in a statement.
The new chip, which allows the miniaturisation of products, can incorporate a maximum 140 megabit DRAM and is suited for image and information processing as well as data storage, Hitachi said.
The technology can be applied to products such as multimedia and game equipment, digital video disk (DVD) systems, and cellular phones, the company said.
